recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any stronger server validation requirement or mandatory OperationOutcome.issue coding should be handled by a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-6850 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core extensibility issue asking what HTTP response should be returned on create or update when an unknown modifier extension is detected, and whether server validation should check for those extensions; its resolution was to add a note about possible server return values and make no other change.
initial_application: Git commit b58cc25916bd7787982d82331cb5654a4b7bc305, corresponding to svn revision 6392 cited in the Jira comments, added the note that a server could return HTTP 422 with an OperationOutcome when a client PUTs or POSTs a modifier extension it does not know.
additional_context: FHIR-7259 asked the adjacent OperationOutcome error-code/recommendation question for the same modifier-extension wording and was marked already done the day after the #6850 source change. Later FHIR-18353 narrowed the meaning of 'process the data' while preserving rejection as an allowed handling option. source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility, confirming source/extensibility.html is in current build scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/extensibility.html retains the possible server response note requested by FHIR-6850, and later processing-scope edits do not invalidate it.
